The user mentions a project at work impacting public health: "It really struck me during a major project at work where decisions impacted public health – realizing your professional choices carry real-world consequences is another level of adulting!" Looking for any specific years: The user says "as a teenager around 2005" in one of the examples, but in the actual comments, there's no explicit mention of a year tied to a life event. The comments don't reference specific years, so we can't calculate an exact birth year from that.

The lack of specific years makes it hard, but the professional context and references to adulting responsibilities suggest they're not in their teens or early 20s.
